subject: science
domain: Motion and Stability: Forces and Interactions

items.prompt:
A longer stopping time in a collision gives a ____ force.
A) smaller
B) larger
C) zero
D) doubled

steps: Longer stopping time means less force.

items.prompt:
An airbag protects a person by
A) extending the stopping time to reduce force
B) shortening the stop
C) adding force
D) doing nothing
items.answer: A) extending the stopping time to reduce force

steps: Longer stopping time means less force.

items.prompt:
To reduce collision force, a safety device should ____ the stopping time.
A) increase
B) decrease
C) zero out
D) ignore

steps: More stopping time means less force.

items.prompt:
Which better protects a dropped phone?
A) A padded case
B) A thin hard case
C) No case
D) A heavier phone

steps: Padding extends stopping time, reducing force.

items.prompt:
A car's crumple zone works by
A) extending the stopping time to reduce force
B) making the stop faster
C) adding more force
D) removing the brakes
items.answer: A) extending the stopping time to reduce force

items.prompt:
Bending your knees when you land
A) lengthens your stopping time and lowers the force
B) shortens the stop
C) increases the force
D) has no effect
items.answer: A) lengthens your stopping time and lowers the force

items.prompt:
The best playground surface to reduce fall injuries is
A) a soft, cushioned surface that extends stopping time
B) hard concrete
C) solid steel
D) smooth glass
items.answer: A) a soft, cushioned surface that extends stopping time

steps: Cushioning extends stopping time, reducing force.

items.prompt:
All collision safety devices work the same way by
A) extending the stopping time to reduce force
B) shortening the stopping time
C) increasing the force
D) adding mass
items.answer: A) extending the stopping time to reduce force

steps: Longer stopping time lowers the force.
